Resource-specific annotations Resource-specific annotations configure Config Connector to take additional actions beyond creating or deleting resources.

For example, the force-destroy directive is declared in the following YAML snippet. metadata : annotations : cnrm.cloud.google.com/force-destroy : "true" Check each Config Connector resource's reference page to learn resource-specific annotations.
